claim_boundaries: Abstract, sections 3.3-3.5, Table 3, discussion and limitations consistently distinguish computed reference models from measured recruitment. The ATF1 breakpoint span is explicitly not a measured recruitment interval. P1 equivalence and P2/P4 dependence/confounding are disclosed; P5 is untested without a fusion construct, and full-length TCF12 is not substituted. No completed experiment or ATR efficacy result is claimed. Single-source annotation and lack of sequenced patient junctions limit external validity but do not contradict the narrowly stated computational result.
